skill_name: Compare and contrast AI-driven chatbots and virtual agents.
workflow: AI-driven chatbots and virtual agents both use artificial intelligence for various purposes, such as responding to customer inquiries, automating tasks and providing customer service. One key difference between them is that chatbots are designed to respond to user inputs, while virtual agents can actually act on user requests.
